subtitle: Out Manila · ANA
overview: A six-day winter tour of Hokkaido flying ANA from Manila, timed with the Sounkyo Icefall Festival and the Sapporo Snow Festival at Odori Park. See drift ice from the Monbetsu Garinko icebreaker, visit Asahiyama Zoo’s penguin parade, enjoy an onsen dinner at Sounkyo and an all-you-can-eat crab buffet in Sapporo. Hotels range from 3.5 to 5 stars and the package has no shopping stops.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Feb 2–7 2027 to Feb 2–7 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.New Chitose Airport: Sapporo's main airport, where the English-speaking guide meets the group.
placeDesc.Bibai Snowland: A snow playground in Bibai with snow tubing included and other snow activities at own cost.
placeDesc.Sounkyo Icefall Festival: A winter festival in Sounkyo gorge with large ice structures and lights.
placeDesc.Ginga Falls: One of a pair of waterfalls near Sounkyo, visited together with Ryusei Falls.
placeDesc.Ryusei Falls: One of a pair of waterfalls near Sounkyo, visited together with Ginga Falls.
placeDesc.Crab Claw Statue: A giant crab claw monument in Monbetsu, a well-known photo stop.
placeDesc.Monbetsu Icebreaker: An icebreaker ship cruise to watch drifting sea ice off the Monbetsu coast.
placeDesc.Asahiyama Zoo: A famous Asahikawa zoo, visited for the Penguin Parade.
placeDesc.Odori Park: Sapporo's central park and the main site of the Sapporo Snow Festival.
placeDesc.Tanukikoji Shopping Street: A long covered shopping arcade in downtown Sapporo.
placeDesc.Hill of the Buddha: A Sapporo site with a large Buddha statue, designed by architect Tadao Ando.
placeDesc.Shiroi Koibito Park: A chocolate-themed attraction in Sapporo by the maker of the Shiroi Koibito cookies.
placeDesc.Mitsui Outlet Mall: An outlet shopping mall near Sapporo with free time for shopping.
placeDesc.Lake Shikotsu: A caldera lake near Chitose, known for its winter Ice Festival.
